verdict.rationale: The only evidence on this story is community commentary saying Jira has a saved-search capability, though users find building a useful one painful. That signals usability friction, not a contradiction, so it is not a dispute. The pack has no first-party documentation of saved filters, and nothing shows that a saved view can be shared via a link. Missing for 10: first-party docs on saving filtered views (saved filters/JQL), evidence of sharing a saved view via a link, hands-on corroboration of sharing permissions.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can save a filtered view of work and share it with a link

citations.quote: create a useful saved search in JIRA
